# Reveal.js runtime

This directory contains the browser runtime files from **reveal.js 5.2.1**,
including the speaker-notes plugin, for an offline presentation.

- Upstream: [hakimel/reveal.js](https://github.com/hakimel/reveal.js/tree/5.2.1)
- Package: [reveal.js 5.2.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/reveal.js/v/5.2.1)
- License: [MIT license and attribution](LICENSE)

Only `reset.css`, `reveal.css`, `reveal.js`, `notes.js` and the license are vendored.
The application does not depend on this framework. Project styles are in
[theme.css](../theme.css) and slides in [index.html](../index.html).
